cds.title: Florida Gulf Coast University Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF; the 2025-26 edition is not posted)

ipeds.title: IPEDS via NCES College Navigator - Florida Gulf Coast University (student-to-faculty ratio)

stats.notes: Fall 2024 first-year class (CDS C1). International applicants 473 and admits 166 (35% vs 63% overall; 88% in-state, 53% out-of-state), so an international applicant is far from guaranteed. Undergrad enrollment and intl count are B1/B2 totals (14,434; nonresident 347). GPA 4.12 is the average weighted high school GPA (C12). C11 distribution is for all enrolled students. FGCU has no waitlist (C2).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2026): SAT or ACT 'required to be considered for admission'; C8F says scores are not required for first-time applicants earning an AA.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (2025-26, first-year): in-state tuition $4,191, non-resident tuition $22,328, required fees $1,927, on-campus food and housing $10,102; G5 books $1,200, transportation $2,750, other $2,750. College Navigator lists out-of-state tuition and fees of $25,162 (about $900 more than the CDS sum). H6: only non-need-based institutional aid is available to nonresidents; 179 received it (avg $10,330).
